description: This file defines the AdoNetRemindersProviderBuilder class which implements the IProviderBuilder interface for configuring ADO.NET based reminder service in Orleans Silo. It includes a method to set up the reminder service with configuration options.

classes.name: AdoNetRemindersProviderBuilder
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IProviderBuilder for configuring ADO.NET reminders in Orleans Silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder to use AdoNetReminderService with options set from configuration section.
